difficulty_reason: The author exploits an impredicative proposition U to construct a surjective self-evaluation map. Its right inverse requires case analysis on proposition equality and Hedberg uniqueness to identify the resulting equality transport; Lawvere diagonalization then forces a fixed point of negation and hence proof irrelevance. The interplay of restricted CIC elimination, transport and impredicative diagonalization exceeds routine graduate exercises; H2 is supported without counting the standard supporting theorems as separate items.
core_obligations: Preserve minimal CIC universes, propositional versus computational elimination and exact definite-equality/PI conventions.

Preserve the entire U/s/i construction, transport case split, fixed-point argument and final proof-irrelevance implication without added extensionality or choice assumptions.
